name: Optimal Scanline Voxelization (Floating-Point)
definition: A 2D line voxelization technique for triangle slices that minimizes the number of voxels by ensuring no voxel exists between two parallel scanlines separated by a distance l.
summary: Optimal Scanline Voxelization generates discrete voxel representations of triangle slices by dynamically calculating a maximum safe step size to skip intermediate voxels, minimizing total count.
